title: UI Systems Lab
summary: A browsable Storybook catalog of interface foundations, components, modules and workflow patterns, with Vite and TanStack Start as supporting prototype spaces.
scope: One Storybook catalog, two application prototype environments

sources.label: Vite UI starter README and source
TanStack Start UI starter README and source
Portfolio framing clarified by the project owner, October 26, 2026

sections.title: One catalog, not three projects
sections.body: The Storybook catalog is the main artifact of this independent lab. It organizes interface building blocks and working patterns in one place so I can examine how individual design decisions behave in code. Vite and TanStack Start are supporting prototype environments, not separate portfolio projects.

evidence.note: The owner specified one Storybook project with Vite and TanStack explained as prototype spaces.
The README identifies packages/ui as the component, token, and Storybook catalog.

sections.title: Two spaces for trying ideas
sections.body: The catalog is the reference point. The application starters provide different contexts in which to try the same kinds of UI patterns: lightweight screen composition and route-based application exploration.

items.title: Vite / Screen prototypes
items.summary: A lightweight app for composing screens, trying layouts, and iterating on individual workspace or project views.

items.title: TanStack Start / Application prototypes
items.summary: A routed app environment for exploring pages, navigation, and how patterns work across multiple screens.

evidence.note: The Vite README describes apps/web as a demo page, with optional area pages and no application router.
The TanStack README documents file routes in apps/web for pages and area views.

sections.title: What the Storybook catalog contains
sections.body: Storybook organizes the reusable pieces into five groups. Foundations establish the visual rules; layout and components provide the parts; modules compose those parts; patterns demonstrate ways to handle larger workflows.

items.title: Foundations
items.summary: Color, type, spacing, sizing, radius, shadow and motion.

items.title: Modules
items.summary: Shell, forms, detail and table compositions.

items.title: Patterns
items.summary: Workflow examples such as record creation, onboarding and task management.

evidence.note: The README documents the Foundations, Layout, Components, Modules and Patterns Storybook groups and representative subjects.
The parallel TanStack README documents the same catalog taxonomy.

sections.title: A place to keep decisions visible
sections.body: This is an ongoing working reference, rather than a finished customer product or a claim of measured impact. The value of showing it here is the relationship between design decisions, reusable patterns and prototype implementation. The two starter repositories are parallel implementations, not one automatically shared runtime.

evidence.note: The owner describes the starter environments as prototype spaces in a portfolio lab.
The Vite source is a separate starter project.
The TanStack Start source is a separate starter project.
